# Cross-domain inquiry

> Public orientation and contribution route for an unresolved cross-domain inquiry on systems, continuity, consequence, transition, access, and governance.

## Primary
- https://crossdomain-inquiry.github.io/
- https://crossdomain-inquiry.github.io/invitation
- https://crossdomain-inquiry.github.io/response

## Contribution
- https://github.com/crossdomain-inquiry/crossdomain-inquiry.github.io/issues/new
- mailto:Crossdomain-inquiry@outlook.com

The inquiry does not require agreement, a particular vocabulary, or continuing participation. One-time analytical contributions are welcome; longer involvement can be discussed separately.
